cohort: The study included nulligravida women, women who had only vaginal delivery 1-3 years prior, and women who had only cesarean delivery 1-3 years prior.
finding: Women who had given birth via either vaginal or cesarean delivery exhibited impaired somatosensory postural control compared to nulligravida women.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery group showed lower antero-posterior and medio-lateral somatosensory test scores compared to both control and vaginal delivery groups, while the vaginal delivery group also had lower antero-posterior somatosensory values compared to controls.
